meta.name: meta-ads
meta.description: Manage Meta Ads (Facebook + Instagram) — performance, ROAS, CPM, frequency, audience overlap, learning phase, creative fatigue, budgets, ad sets, campaigns, ads. Use for any mention of Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, or campaign settings on Meta.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Meta 广告投放与效果优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Facebook 或 Instagram 上投放广告并需要管理投放效果。
copy.tagline_en: Manage Meta Ads performance and optimization
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run ads on Facebook or Instagram and need to manage campaign performance.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你分析并优化 Meta 广告（Facebook 和 Instagram）。它可以查看广告表现、诊断创意疲劳、学习阶段问题、受众重叠等，并给出调整建议（如暂停广告、调整预算），但修改前会先征求你的同意。
howto.when: 当你提到 Meta 广告、Facebook 广告、Instagram 广告、ROAS、CPM、广告花费、广告系列设置等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看最近7天广告系列的ROAS和CPM趋势。
say.note: Claude 会拉取数据并分析表现。

say.text: 检查一下有没有广告组处于学习受限状态。
say.note: Claude 会诊断学习阶段问题并给出建议。

say.text: 这个广告组的频次超过3了，是不是该换素材？
say.note: Claude 会分析创意疲劳并建议刷新。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze and optimize Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram). It reviews performance, diagnoses creative fatigue, learning phase issues, audience overlap, etc., and suggests actions (e.g., pause ads, adjust budgets) but asks for approval before making changes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Meta Ads, Facebook Ads, Instagram Ads, ROAS, CPM, ad spend, campaign settings, or related keywords.

say_en.text: Show me the ROAS and CPM trend for the last 7 days.
say_en.note: Claude fetches data and analyzes performance.

say_en.text: Check if any ad sets are in learning limited status.
say_en.note: Claude diagnoses learning phase issues and suggests fixes.

say_en.text: This ad set has frequency >3, should we refresh creatives?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes creative fatigue and recommends refresh.
